verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is an open-source library that runs locally via `AsyncWebCrawler` and needs no forced API keys. It also ships an optimized Docker image with a FastAPI server, plus a monitoring dashboard and playground, and its docs have a dedicated self-hosting section. Community posts call it an open-source library and describe one-click Docker setups built around it. Missing for 10: an independent hands-on report of a production self-hosted deployment, and explicit license terms in the evidence.
